The bench underlined the necessity for collaboration among all parties to effectively manage firecracker usage. Measures taken by the Delhi government include restrictions on older vehicles and staggered work hours.

Together, both parties aim to fortify economic partnerships and jointly innovate in sectors like artificial intelligence and supercomputing, consequently navigating shared interests and global challenges.

description: A Mississippi father left his family home and 0.86 acres of land equally to his three children in a 2008 will but transferred the property to his wife in 2021. After his death, his daughter challenged the transfer, claiming he had been improperly influenced due to his declining health. On Tuesday, an appeals court rejected her challenge, finding insufficient evidence of undue influence.

title: Michael Dell hails Trump Accounts as donor push grows
description: Michael Dell has endorsed the Trump Accounts initiative, which aims to provide American children with stock market investments. The program has opened approximately 9 million accounts for children under 18 and further plans to create accounts for all 70 million eligible kids. High-profile donors, including Gwynne Shotwell and Ray Dalio, are contributing funds to expand its reach.

description: US government has declared a national emergency to address security risks posed by foreign-made electricity equipment. An executive order has been signed, allowing tighter restrictions on potentially dangerous foreign equipment. The new measures aim to protect the national grid from cyberattacks and supply disruptions. This initiative could also boost domestic manufacturers as reliance on potentially vulnerable foreign suppliers is reduced.

title: XUV700 booked in 2022, never delivered: Mahindra ordered to refund and pay Rs 62k
description: A consumer in Haryana sought redress after Mahindra & Mahindra failed to deliver a booked SUV. The booking was made in February 2022, but the vehicle was never delivered to the customer. The manufacturer and dealer provided contradictory claims regarding the situation surrounding the delayed delivery. Consequently, the consumer commission found both parties guilty of unfair trade practices and ordered compensation.

California couple wins garden rights after neighbour’s 1955 deal for $250
description: A California couple who bought a home in 2019 found themselves in a legal battle after their neighbour claimed ownership of a 20-by-20-foot garden they believed was theirs. The dispute centred on a 1955 agreement involving $250, babysitting services and land access rights. On Monday, a California appeals court upheld the couple's exclusive right to use the garden.

title: Florida court reverses HOA auction cancellation made without hearing buyer
description: A Florida homeowner paid his outstanding homeowners' association fees five days after his property was sold at a foreclosure auction in October 2024. The sale was subsequently cancelled, but the winning bidder challenged the decision, saying it had not been heard. Nearly two years later, a Florida appeals court overturned the cancellation and ordered a fresh hearing.

title: Andre Agassi’s $6.5M Las Vegas land sells for $18.15M in 2026
description: Andre Agassi sold his 1.8-acre homesite in Las Vegas’ exclusive Summit Club for $18.15 million, nearly tripling the $6.5 million he paid in 2018. The sale generated an $11.65 million gain before expenses. His brother, Phillip Agassi, said the tennis legend reconsidered building a large mansion as his children grow older. The buyer’s identity remains unknown, while the property’s location and luxury surroundings add to its appeal.

title: Kelces’ Garage Beer sales surge 252% as $14M-barrel rival looms
description: Jason and Travis Kelce’s Garage Beer has emerged as a rising player in the US beer market, recording 252% sales growth in 2023 before the brothers invested in 2024. With 95 calories per serving and distribution across all 50 states, the brand is targeting mainstream light beer drinkers. Garage Beer expects to reach 300,000 barrels, but competing with established giants such as Michelob Ultra remains a significant challenge as it seeks long-term growth.
